title: Uniqueness of the dissipative SQG without time-continuity assumption
summary: We consider the uniqueness of the solution of the dissipative surface quasi-geostrophic equation, without assuming time-continuity and smallness of the solutions. We show that the uniqueness holds in the scale-critical Lebesgue spaces and non-homogeneous Besov spaces. The proof is based on the energy method, inspired by the approach introduced by Lions and Masmoudi (2001) in the study of uniqueness for the Navier-Stokes equations.
